environment.isolation: fresh identical filesystem per observation; explicit PWD equals actual cwd; ancestor permission controls applied after provisioning and restored before removal
environment.dynamicQueries: input programs assert exact expected answers for cwd-dependent query output, preserve query status, and print unexpected answers on failure; all captured bytes remain unchanged; ordinary relative command -v output is direct
environment.comparison: stdout bytes and exit status; stderr retained as diagnostics, not compared
